summary: Sound event dispatcher. Reads an event ID from *(a2 + 12) and switches on it, routing each ID to a dedicated handler invoked as handler(a4, a1, params[i], 0[, flag]). The params index used (a3[4], a3[5] or a3[6]) and the trailing flag vary per event ID. A random even/odd variant flag v6 is computed from two RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator calls before dispatch. Default case assigns result 0; case 0x2C returns the initialized default -1. Dispatched by FontRenderingPrep (0x00411840) and marked as on the audio subsystem.

operations.description: Initialize defaultResult v4 = -1; this is the value returned when a case falls through to LABEL_26 without overwriting result, notably case 0x2C.

Compute randomEvenFlag v6 = (RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator() % 2 == 0), then call RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator() a second time with the result discarded. v6 is passed as the variant flag to SessionStringNameLookup calls.
Read event ID from *(a2 + 12) and switch on it. Dispatch is compiled through jump table jpt_411ED0 (0x00412218) with case-value table byte_412280 (0x00412280).

sub_412E50(a4, a1, params[i], 0): case 0xE with params[4]; cases 0x13 and 0x29 with params[5].
TextAttributeLookup_3600(a4, a1, params[i], 0): case 1 with params[4]; cases 0x18 and 0x19 with params[5].
TextAttributeLookup_3710(a4, a1, params[i], 0): case 2 with params[4]; cases 0x16 and 0x1A with params[5].
sub_413820(a4, a1, params[i], 0): case 0x1F with params[5]; case 0x2A with params[6].

SeasonSpecificTeamIDLookup(a4, a1, params[i], 0): case 0x14 with params[4]; case 0x30 with params[5].
Return the handler result. Default case sets result = 0 then falls to LABEL_26; case 0x2C returns defaultResult v4 = -1.
